name: Komatsu Light Armored Vehicle
armament: 5.56 mm Minimi or 7.62 mm MG on roof hatch
protection: Light armour against small arms. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Small boxy 4x4 with a nearly vertical windscreen and flat panels
Round roof hatch with pintle MG, four doors with small armoured windows
Deployed in Iraq and on overseas evacuations; replacement under selection (Eagle V and Hawkei trialled)
